task: WE-1 POS Cashier Loyalty CTA — adversarial defect probe
stance: challenge constructively; find what GREEN tests miss

findings.summary: 5 adversarial threat scenarios examined. 2 are caught by existing defenses (server-side). 2 are mitigated by recommended client-side guards. 1 is an inherent CASH-wizard limitation already flagged by Architect — document, do not block.

threats.title: Double-click race: CTA clicked twice while modal opening
threats.scenario: Cashier taps CTA twice in rapid succession. Modal's :open=true emitted twice. Internally Vue dedupes the boolean watcher (PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue:225-243 only fires on transition). However if user types code+points, clicks Apply, then accidentally re-opens modal, lastResponse may show stale success band.
threats.current_defense: Modal has `if (!this.canApply || this.loading) return;` guard in submitApply (line 290). Loading state prevents concurrent submit. Backend idempotency key includes minute-bucket timestamp + code + points, so server-side dedupe is 60s.
threats.fix_required: NO — existing defenses sufficient. Optional: modal could reset errorMessage/successMessage on open watch (already does — line 228-231).

threats.title: Redemption-after-payment race: cashier clicks Loyalty CTA AS payment confirms
threats.scenario: Cashier confirms CASH payment via wizard at t=0. Order created with payment_status=PAID at t=10ms (server). order:confirmed event fires at t=20ms. Cashier had clicked Loyalty CTA at t=5ms — modal open. Cashier submits at t=100ms with the stale orderId now PAID.
threats.current_defense: Backend PosRedemptionService.assertOrderRedeemable() rejects PAID orders with 422 ORDER_ALREADY_FINALIZED (PosRedemptionService.php:232-240). Modal maps to translateErrorCode → 'order_already_finalized' i18n message.
threats.fix_required: NO — server is authoritative. Modal UI surfaces clear error; cashier sees 'cette commande est déjà payée' and closes modal.

threats.title: Stale order-id binding after multi-order session
threats.scenario: Cashier creates order #1 (non-PAID). currentLoyaltyOrderId=1. Cashier creates order #2 without resetCart (some flows allow). currentLoyaltyOrderId is now 2 OR 1 depending on event order. If event order is racy, cashier opens modal targeting WRONG order.
threats.current_defense: PaymentComponent's order:confirmed always emits the just-confirmed order. order:confirmed handler in PosComponent overwrites currentLoyaltyOrderId with the latest payload — last-write-wins, deterministic.
threats.fix_required: RECOMMEND: explicit clear on resetCart AND on resetPaymentForm (which fires after each order cycle), so the stale-id window between order #1 finalization and order #2 creation is narrowed. Architect spec already includes this.

threats.title: Permission downgrade: cashier loses pos.redeem-loyalty mid-session
threats.scenario: Admin revokes pos.redeem-loyalty from cashier role at t=0 (Spatie permission cache invalidated). Cashier clicks Loyalty CTA at t=1m. Modal opens (no permission check client-side per LOCK design — server is gate).
threats.current_defense: Backend FormRequest authz returns 403 with permission_denied code. Modal translateErrorCode → 'pos.loyalty.redeem.errors.permission_denied' shown in role='alert' band.
threats.fix_required: NO — by design, server is single source of truth for authz. Hiding CTA based on cached permission would create false-negative UX for legitimate cashiers post permission grant.

threats.title: Already-redeemed double-apply attempt
threats.scenario: Cashier applies 500pts to order #42 → success. Cashier reopens modal on same order. Modal pre-fills nothing (state cleared on watch open). Cashier types another code + 500pts → submits.
threats.current_defense: Backend PosRedemptionService rejects with already_redeemed code (one redemption per order is the LOCK invariant). Modal shows 'Une réduction fidélité a déjà été appliquée à cette commande.'
threats.fix_required: NO — server invariant enforced. Optionally: track applied=true in PosComponent.data and disable CTA after successful apply (cleared on resetCart). RECOMMEND as a UX polish.

threats.title: Subtotal mutation: order total changes after redemption
threats.scenario: Cashier applies 500pts (5€ discount) to 12€ order → total=7€. Cashier adds item via PosOrderShow edit flow → subtotal jumps to 20€. Discount stays 5€ — no recompute.
threats.current_defense: Backend pricing recalc on order update strips loyalty discount or revalidates against subtotal. Per LOCK §6, redemption is final on apply.
threats.severity: P2 (potential SSOT drift if backend doesn't revalidate)
threats.fix_required: OUT OF SCOPE — this is a PosOrderShow edit-flow concern, not the main-page CTA. Document in V1.0.2 backlog if not already covered.

threats.title: Empty cart loyalty intent: cashier opens CTA with carts.length=0
threats.scenario: Cashier accidentally clicks CTA when cart is empty. currentLoyaltyOrderId=null. Modal disabled state shows greyed button.
threats.current_defense: Recommended UX state machine: CTA disabled when currentLoyaltyOrderId=null. Modal can't open via disabled button.
threats.fix_required: RECOMMEND: PosV5Button :disabled="!canShowLoyaltyCta" attribute. Already in Architect spec.

threats.title: Modal open then route change: leaks listener
threats.scenario: Cashier opens modal → navigates to /admin/pos-orders/list mid-modal. Modal still mounted in PosComponent tree if PosComponent is parent. On route exit, modal listeners (esc key handler) may not unbind cleanly.
threats.current_defense: PosComponent unmounted on route change → modal unmounted with it → Vue cleans up watchers + DOM listeners automatically. Modal has no manual listener setup in onMounted (only nextTick focus).

false_positives_we_might_get: Vitest GREEN does not prove visual placement is correct. Playwright capture mandatory.
PHPUnit 6/6 PosLoyaltyRedeemTest stays GREEN does NOT validate Vue wire-up — pure backend test.
JS suite GREEN does NOT prove integration with PaymentComponent event chain — recommend manual sanity via Playwright dispatching synthetic order:confirmed.

p2_minors: RED-3 (stale order id between order cycles) — fixed by explicit clear on resetCart/resetPaymentForm.
RED-6 (subtotal mutation post-redeem) — out of scope, V1.0.2 backlog.
p3_polish: RED-5 (double-apply UX) — recommend track applied=true client-side.
RED-7 (empty cart CTA) — disable button when no order.
production_risk_assessment.verdict: NO P0/P1 blockers found. Proceed with build, ensure Architect spec's three reset hooks (order:confirmed, resetCart, resetPaymentForm) all clear currentLoyaltyOrderId. Test plan must include both 'visible-then-hidden' and 'stale-id-rejected' scenarios.

findings.convergence_recommendation: GO. Risk surface is low. Server-side guards (idempotency, terminal-state rejection, permission gate, already-redeemed invariant) form the primary defense. UI is a discoverability + reset-semantics layer. Document CASH-wizard limitation explicitly.
